## 4. For new NIGHTLY source, do not reuse old binaries or patches

If native GitHub is reachable:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/gobbajogger/X0X37-for-Loopy-Pro.git x0x37-nightly-source
cd x0x37-nightly-source
git fetch origin nightly
git checkout --detach origin/nightly
git rev-parse HEAD HEAD^{tree}
git status --porcelain
```

Check the full SHA/tree against fresh connected GitHub refs, verify current `BUILDING.md` toolchain/SDK pins and run the same three native commands. When native GitHub DNS fails, transfer a **complete verified source bundle** or reconstruct and verify compiled files using GitHub connector Git blobs/tree as above. Never label an old synthetic snapshot as latest. **Compilation proceeds even if PR is draft, QA incomplete, Pages/catalog absent, external hosting unresolved, or hardware unavailable.** A compiler PASS remains `BUILD_SUCCEEDED_UNREVIEWED` even when later acceptance fails.

Production `main` and public production picker still require model-matched physical owner PASS and express production promotion authorization. Never distribute JieLi closed controller bytes unless specific rights are established. No public firmware/sample/toolchain/SDK upload to the separate browser/status NIGHTLY repository.
